academy.eyebrow: PRIMARY PRODUCT // NAMIBIAN OHS QUALIFICATION LADDER
academy.headline: Precision safety education built for Namibian industry.
academy.lead: Structured Occupational Health & Safety programmes from Level 1 Site Foundation to Level 6 Applied Hygiene Sensors and Level 7 Strategic EHS - pre-referenced to NTA Unit Standards and Namibian GN 156 of 1997.

courses.title: Foundation Workplace Health & Safety
courses.desc: Workplace hazard identification, safety signs, PPE hierarchies, emergency roll-call, and worker rights & duties under the Namibian Labour Act 11 of 2007.
courses.standards: Aligned: NTA Unit Std 1157 (7 Credits) | Labour Act s. 39

courses.title: Workplace SHE Representative & Risk Control
courses.desc: Statutory SHE Representative inspections, incident recording, toolbox talk facilitation, fire prevention, and task risk matrices.
courses.standards: Aligned: NTA IDs 935 & LW02 | Labour Act s. 43-44

courses.title: Supervisory OHS & Environmental Responsibility
courses.desc: Frontline supervisory safety leadership, contractor control, permit-to-work execution, environmental waste control, and root-cause investigation.
courses.standards: Aligned: NTA Unit Stds 846 & 847 | GN 156 of 1997

courses.title: National Vocational Certificate in OHS
courses.desc: Comprehensive Safety Officer operations: safe work procedures, employee welfare supervision, training needs matrices, H&S committees, and safety device maintenance.
courses.standards: Aligned: NTA Unit Stds 848-853, 859 & 2061

courses.title: National Vocational Diploma in OHS Management
courses.desc: Enterprise HSE management systems, quantitative BowTie risk modeling, internal compliance auditing, multi-agency emergency command, and mining/construction project safety.
courses.standards: Aligned: NTA Unit Stds 854-858, 860 & 1929

courses.title: Diploma in Applied OHS Instrumentation & Hygiene
courses.desc: Field technologist practicals: 4-gas PID/catalytic sensor calibration, gravimetric silica/uranium dust sampling, 85 dBA noise zoning, WBGT heat stress, and NRPA radiation dosimetry.
courses.standards: Aligned: GN 156/1997 A.I.A. | NRPA Act 5 of 2005

courses.title: Advanced Diploma in Strategic EHS, PSM & ESG
courses.desc: MEFT Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA/EMP), Process Safety Management (Green Hydrogen & Petrochemical), occupational epidemiology, and ISO 45001/14001 Lead Auditing.
courses.standards: Aligned: EMA Act 7 of 2007 | ISO 45001/14001 Lead Auditor

safeman.brandSub: SAMTRAC-Style Corporate HSE & Practicum Tickets • safeman.oryxinstitute.org
safeman.eyebrow: SECONDARY PRODUCT // PROPRIETARY SAMTRAC-STYLE INDUSTRY SUITE
safeman.headline: High-impact corporate safety management & practical tickets.
safeman.lead: Our proprietary green-label B2B benchmark engineered around ISO 45001:2018, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 31000, and hands-on emergency practicums (CPR, First Aid, Firefighting, Heights, Confined Space & LOTO).

courses.title: SafeMan Core: Safety Management System
courses.desc: Our flagship SAMTRAC-equivalent programme: ISO 45001 architecture, ISO 31000 HIRA & BowTie barriers, e-PTW contractor governance, ISO 14001 environmental control, ICAM investigation & auditing.

courses.title: Basic Life Support, CPR & Choking
courses.desc: DRABC primary survey, adult/child CPR (30:2 compressions at 100-120 bpm), AED defibrillator pad placement, Heimlich airway obstruction relief, and recovery position.
courses.standards: Pre-Ref: NTA ID 843 & 844 | GN 156 Reg. 228

courses.title: Workplace First Aid Responder
courses.desc: Catastrophic bleeding & trauma dressings, burn cooling & sterile care, limb fracture splinting, shock management, snakebite/heat exhaustion protocol, and statutory first aid box control.
courses.standards: Pre-Ref: NTA ID 843 & 844 | GN 156 First Aid Regs

courses.title: Basic Firefighting & Fire Marshal
courses.desc: Fire classes (A, B, C, D, Electrical), DCP & CO2 extinguisher selection, live PASS technique drill, fire blanket smothering, hose reels, and emergency assembly roll-call command.
courses.standards: Pre-Ref: NTA ID 1763 & 1157 | Fire Brigade Act 5 of 2006 (Namibia)

courses.title: Working at Heights & Fall Arrest
courses.desc: Fall factor & clearance physics, full-body harness pre-use inspection, shock-absorbing lanyards, 100% twin-hook tie-off, scaffolding tag compliance, and suspension trauma rescue.
courses.standards: Pre-Ref: GN 156 Reg. 39-45 | NTA ID 849

courses.title: Confined Space & Gas Testing
courses.desc: Atmospheric stratification testing (O2, LEL, H2S, CO), 4-gas detector zero/bump verification, confined space entry permits, standby attendant duties, and tripod non-entry rescue.
courses.standards: Pre-Ref: GN 156 Reg. 163 | NTA ID 848

courses.title: Lockout / Tagout Energy Isolation
courses.desc: 6-step hazardous energy isolation (electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, mechanical), multi-lock hasps, personal padlocks, danger tags, and mandatory Zero-Energy Try-Out verification.
courses.standards: Pre-Ref: GN 156 Machinery Regs | NTA ID 2061

courses.title: Task HIRA & DSTI Facilitator
courses.desc: Baseline vs. issue-based HIRA, 5x5 consequence/likelihood grading, Hierarchy of Controls, leading Daily Safe Task Instructions (DSTIs), and Section 42 right to refuse unsafe work.
courses.standards: ISO 31000 | Pre-Ref: NTA ID 855 | Labour Act s. 42

courses.title: Respirable Crystalline Silica & Dust Control
courses.desc: Silica exposure in quarrying, mining and construction; gravimetric sampling, wet-cutting and LEV engineering controls, RPE fit-testing, and the exposure-action-value discipline.
courses.standards: Pre-Ref: GN 156 A.I.A. Regs | ISO 45001 / NIOSH hierarchy

courses.title: Noise Conservation & Hearing Protection
courses.desc: 85 dBA action level, noise mapping and zoning, dosimetry, muff vs plug selection and NRR discipline, audiometric baseline and shift testing, and engineering noise control.
courses.standards: Pre-Ref: GN 156 Reg. 175 | ISO 1999

courses.title: Permit to Work Authorised Person
courses.desc: Hot work, cold work, confined space and electrical permits; isolations, gas test results, handover and hand-back discipline; and the authorised/performing authority split.
courses.standards: ISO 45001 Op. control | Pre-Ref: GN 156 Reg. 163 & Machinery Regs

courses.title: Incident Investigation & ICAM
courses.desc: Near-miss reporting culture, evidence preservation, the ICAM framework (organisational factors to front-line acts), timeline reconstruction, and corrective action tracking to closure.
courses.standards: ISO 45001 Cl. 10 | ICAM (BHP-adapted) | Labour Act reporting

courses.title: Environmental Awareness & Waste Control
courses.desc: ISO 14001 aspects and impacts, waste streams and the 4R hierarchy, hazardous waste manifests, spill control and bunding, and Namibian EMA duty-of-care basics.
courses.standards: ISO 14001:2015 | EMA Act 7 of 2007 (Namibia) | Basel conventions
